title: Free Grill Course for Nuevo Laredo Youth Today — and More Free Events This Month
excerpt: Young people ages 15 to 20 in Nuevo Laredo can take a free grill course today, Sunday, November 15, from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. at Boulevard Díaz Ordaz 2401, Colonia Hipódromo.
content:
Young people in Nuevo Laredo have a free chance to learn a trade today. The municipal government, through the Instituto Municipal para el Desarrollo de la Juventud (IMJUVE), is offering a free grill course — Curso Parrillero — this Sunday, November 15, from 8:00 in the morning to 3:00 in the afternoon.

The course is for young people ages 15 to 20, and it is completely free. It takes place at Boulevard Díaz Ordaz 2401, Colonia Hipódromo, in collaboration with Carnes Don Güero. Participants will learn techniques for preparing cuts of meat, handling the grill, and building cooking skills in a hands-on, social setting. Spots are limited, and registration is open through an online form.

The course is part of the administration of Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal, which has been rolling out free workshops and activities for young people across the city.

More free events this month

The grill course is not the only free offering on the calendar. From November 18 to 20, the city is holding an urban gardens workshop — Taller de Huertos Urbanos — at the Plaza de la Mujer, from 10:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. each day. Organized by the Instituto Municipal de la Mujer (INMUJER) with the Coordinación General de Gestión Ambiental, it teaches residents how to grow food at home and turn small spaces into green areas.

And on Sunday, November 22, at 7:00 p.m., the city invites families to a free performance of the Guelaguetza Oaxaqueña — music, dance and tradition from the state of Oaxaca — at the Teatro Principal of the Centro Cultural. Admission is free.

For families on both sides of the river, the message is simple: the free programs are there, and the seats go to whoever signs up first.
